title: package.json "hinmil" key
description: Validates the "hinmil" key of package.json for the HinMil language server. All other package.json properties are untouched.

hinmil.markdownDescription: HinMil configuration. In an application this is the project-level config (`enable`, `globals`, `overrides`, `typesDir`, `settings`); in a published library it declares the package's `.hm` sidecars (`sidecars`, `globals`).

enable.markdownDescription: Run the HinMil language server for this project. Set to `false` to disable HinMil from within the repository itself (no editor settings needed).

globals.markdownDescription: Paths to globals file(s), relative to the package root. Each entry's contents are concatenated (in order). In a project: forms the project-wide globals. In a published library: auto-appended to consumer engine globals whenever the package is imported.

overrides.markdownDescription: Per-package `.hm` override sidecars keyed by bare package name (e.g. `"sqlkit": "./hm-types/sqlkit.hm"`). The override is merged on top of the package's own sidecar.

typesDir.markdownDescription: Directory (relative to the project root) for conventional `<typesDir>/<pkg>.hm` package type stubs. Default: `hm-types`.

sidecars.markdownDescription: Library authors: `.hm` sidecar path(s) declaring this package's exports/methods, read by consumers when they import the package.
